title: Factory v1: Pause admission and emergency-stop active workers
body:
## Change

Expose durable pause and emergency-stop controls for an active iteration, preventing later admission/merge while retaining checkpoints and artifacts for explicit recovery.

## Done

- Public pause stops new admission, checkpoints the active stage and prevents subsequent controller merges. The merge boundary rechecks pause immediately before external mutation.
- Checkpoints retain active assignment/run, pinned inputs, candidate artifacts, stage evidence and pending external intents.
- Emergency stop terminates the actual worker process/container/helper tree promptly, preventing uncontrolled continuation while preserving available diagnostics.
- Control responses and readbacks distinguish requested, acknowledged and completed pause/stop states. Only explicit resume authorizes later dispatch.
- Completed or in-flight external operations are reconciled truthfully, not claimed undone. Neither pause nor stop closes issues or discards branch/PR evidence.
- Real pause/kill during an isolated assignment and public concurrency/race checks show no newly admitted work/merge, actual worker termination and retained artifacts.

## Context

Parent #3; first implementation milestone only, not the full-product backlog. Stories: US-35, US-36. Parent acceptance scenarios: 8.

[Pinned fresh specification](https://github.com/tehioant/agentic-forge/blob/cccb21e35cc989a1ecd5a3c88f0689a694d77d9c/docs/specs/fresh-agentic-factory.md) · [Pinned interview decisions](https://github.com/tehioant/agentic-forge/blob/cccb21e35cc989a1ecd5a3c88f0689a694d77d9c/docs/specs/fresh-agentic-factory-interview-decisions.md).

## Constraint

Pause does not roll back an already committed external merge. Restart reconciliation belongs to the next slice.

## Blocked by

- #17 — Factory v1: Autonomously merge a validated candidate and verify integrated delivery
